question.text: What total penalty was imposed on Bybit Fintech Limited (VDA Service Provider) by FIU-IND?

explanation.text: The Logic: Per Series XXIV page 121, FIU-IND imposed a total penalty of Rs. 9,27,00,000 on Bybit Fintech Limited. Bybit is described as a VDA Service Provider that expanded services in India without mandatory FIU-IND registration, leading to website blocking and findings of violations of Section 12 of PMLA read with the PML Rules. The Trap: Rs. 5,49,00,000 is the Paytm Payments Bank penalty, not the Bybit penalty. Rs. 1 crore and Rs. 40 lakh are not the Bybit figures on page 121. Note: Anchor the answer on the Rs. 9,27,00,000 figure and Bybit's VDA SP status as recorded on page 121.
